translations.web: Don’t be furious, Yahweh. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.
translations.bsb: Do not be angry, O LORD, beyond measure; do not remember our iniquity forever. Oh, look upon us, we pray; we are all Your people!
translations.kjv: Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
translations.asv: Be not wroth very sore, O Jehovah, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, look, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
